description:
Hernán Malon, The villain who tore apart the beautiful lovers Calix and Luce, experiences four deaths and four regressions.

The reason why he went back in time once more, clinging to his frail heart – In the fifth life granted to him as his last, Hernán resolves to live solely for Calix’s happiness. However, the problem is that Hernán is not the only one to have travelled back in time whilst retaining his memories.

*“It’s a pleasure to see you, Baron Scala. Congratulations on your rebirth.”*

For some reason, Calyx, who remembers Hernán’s fourth life, says:

*“Don’t even think about dying. There are plenty of ways to bring you back to life.”  
“…….”  
“I look forward to working with you from now on. My husband, and my guardian.”* *(Source: RIDI, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/211034300), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/EC-204), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000089387), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=922007369), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8851298)  
Chapters: [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/EC_192), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8363765), [Joara](https://www.joara.com/book/1617240), [KakaoPage (R15)](https://page.kakao.com/content/59191509/)
